mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fund_info ( id, fund_code, fund_name, fund_type, pinyin_abbr, manager_name, custodian_name, establish_date, benchmark, risk_level, fund_scale, status, source, source_updated_at, business_date, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, quality_status, quality_reason, create_time, update_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{item.id}, #{item.fundCode}, #{item.fundName}, #{item.fundType}, #{item.pinyinAbbr}, #{item.managerName}, #{item.custodianName}, #{item.establishDate}, #{item.benchmark}, #{item.riskLevel}, #{item.fundScale}, #{item.status}, #{item.source}, #{item.sourceUpdatedAt}, #{item.businessDate}, #{item.fetchBatchId}, #{item.dataVersion}, #{item.checksum}, #{item.qualityStatus}, #{item.qualityReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{item.delFlag} ) ON CONFLICT (fund_code) DO UPDATE SET fund_name = EXCLUDED.fund_name, fund_type = EXCLUDED.fund_type, pinyin_abbr = EXCLUDED.pinyin_abbr, manager_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.manager_name, fund_info.manager_name), custodian_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.custodian_name, fund_info.custodian_name), establish_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.establish_date, fund_info.establish_date), benchmark = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.benchmark, fund_info.benchmark), risk_level = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.risk_level, fund_info.risk_level), fund_scale = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fund_scale, fund_info.fund_scale), status = EXCLUDED.status, source = CASE WHEN fund_info.source = 'AKSHARE_XQ' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'AKSHARE_CATALOG' THEN fund_info.source ELSE EXCLUDED.source END, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, business_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.business_date, fund_info.business_date), fetch_batch_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fetch_batch_id, fund_info.fetch_batch_id), data_version = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.data_version, fund_info.data_version), checksum = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.checksum, fund_info.checksum), quality_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.quality_status, fund_info.quality_status), quality_reason = EXCLUDED.quality_reason, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag = 0 WHERE fund_info.fund_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.fund_name OR fund_info.fund_type IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.fund_type OR fund_info.pinyin_abbr IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.pinyin_abbr OR fund_info.manager_name IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.manager_name, fund_info.manager_name) OR fund_info.custodian_name IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.custodian_name, fund_info.custodian_name) OR fund_info.establish_date IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.establish_date, fund_info.establish_date) OR fund_info.benchmark IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.benchmark, fund_info.benchmark) OR fund_info.risk_level IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.risk_level, fund_info.risk_level) OR fund_info.fund_scale IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fund_scale, fund_info.fund_scale) OR fund_info.status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.status OR fund_info.checksum IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.checksum OR fund_info.quality_status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quality_status OR fund_info.quality_reason IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quality_reason
mapper.select: SELECT 'FUND_INFO' AS dataset, fund_code, business_date, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, quality_status, quality_reason, source, source_updated_at AS source_time FROM fund_info WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
